{{Top|leg}}
The '''ionite edge''' was an enhanced [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee]] [[Weapon/Legends|weapon]] [[Edge (weapon)|edge]] that had been augmented by the addition of an ion [[ionite]] alloy. The inverse charge created by this alloy created a disrupting effect to any surrounding electronic systems, most notably [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. This edge had been available in several versions ranging from basic to superior, depending on the strength of the ion charge.
